posts.title: Design is more than creation
posts.description: The conditions a product must survive aren't a test to pass after it's built. They're the inputs that decide what gets made in the first place.

posts.title: Murmuration for growing design teams
posts.description: As design teams grow, staying aligned takes more than more meetings. Lessons from starling murmurations on local decisions, shared context, and room to work.

posts.title: AI chat makes software easier, but not faster, to use
posts.description: New research suggests AI chatbots can reduce clicks and navigation without making tasks faster. What that means for AI UX, delegation, and interface design.
